name: Evidence Contract v1
purpose: Define the stable contract between a learning session, learner performance, progress registration and the next adaptive session.
principles: Evidence belongs to a Can-Do and, when available, to the session and activity that produced it.
A session completion does not imply success; observable performance evidence is required.
Evidence is append-only; progress is derived from evidence history.
Session identity provides traceability without coupling the pedagogical engine to the UI.
Confidence is diagnostic and never replaces performance evidence.
Only the declared assessment activity may produce progress-mutating evidence; recovery activities are support only.

evidenceFields.sessionId: Stable identifier of the session that produced the evidence.
evidenceFields.activityId: Stable identifier of the activity that produced the evidence.
evidenceFields.independent: Whether the learner performed without substantive support.
evidenceFields.dimensions: Normalized observable performance dimensions from 0 to 1.
evidenceFields.assessmentActivityId: Session-level activity identifier that is allowed to produce progress evidence.

lifecycle: planned -> started -> awaiting-evidence -> completed -> register-evidence -> retry-required | next
immutability: Raw evidence records are append-only. Derived status, gaps and reviews may be recalculated from history.
integrityRules: Evidence must match the session identity and target Can-Do.
The evidence activity must be listed in the session contract.
The evidence activity must equal assessmentActivityId.
Recovery activities cannot directly mutate Can-Do progress.
